purpose: Evaluation-only source expectations. These records are never loaded by production discovery or agent definitions.

critical_cases.expected_behavior: With a supplied last name, find matching owners; otherwise list all owners. Empty results produce NOT_FOUND, otherwise map owners to DTOs and return OK.
must_not_claim: This controller alone proves which persistence profile is active
Every operation in the shared ClinicService belongs to owner management
Generic frontend layout is a business responsibility

critical_cases.expected_behavior: Supporting owner retrieval loads related pets and visits.
must_not_claim: Loading related records makes every pet and visit activity part of owner management
A helper is a separate externally reachable entry point without registration evidence

critical_cases.expected_behavior: Pet-type vocabulary is distinct from individual pet records.
must_not_claim: Pet types and individual pets are interchangeable information records

accepted_alternatives: Separate client/owner, animal and visit responsibilities with evidenced dependencies
A broader patient-record responsibility with explicit activity scope and exclusions

critical_cases.expected_behavior: Only unpaid bills accept items. Barcode lookup supplies price/tax details. An existing bill line increments quantity; otherwise create a line, update tender and declare commit. Exception paths declare rollback.
must_not_claim: The procedure returns a response payload
A declared COMMIT proves execution or successful commit
An item can be added to any bill regardless of status

critical_cases.expected_behavior: Reject invalid payment type, nonpositive amount or already-paid bill. Return numeric change on the successful path, NULL after handled errors. Pending bills adjust the remaining amount and suppress a second inventory update. Drawer updates differ for cash and non-cash payment.
must_not_claim: Failure is returned only as an exception
The routine always returns a number rather than nullable NUMBER

critical_cases.expected_behavior: Record a schema login event and query the authorized-IP list. The missing-IP handler does nothing; the access-blocking statement is commented out.
must_not_claim: Unauthorized IP addresses are actively blocked
Schema event recording alone proves a business audit/compliance responsibility

accepted_alternatives: Retail checkout, inventory/replenishment, pricing/tax and workforce/payroll responsibilities with supported shared participation
Broader retail operations groupings with explicit scope, information use and alternatives
